text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is the second G1 sprint<n>race—the Sprinters
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The hill before the finish line at the<n>Nakayama
Racecourse is steep—but<n>that makes this the perfect
opportunity to showcase Taiki<n>Shuttle's talents!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki competes in high spirits, already<n>imagining the
post-race party.
